headline.en: Explore tool-call buffering at explicit window boundaries.
headline.zh: 探索明确窗口边界上的工具调用缓冲。

sub.en: MTP-Align provides a small scheduling state machine that queues tool calls and flushes them at configured token-count boundaries.
sub.zh: MTP-Align 提供小型调度状态机，排队工具调用，并在配置的 token 计数边界刷新。

body.en: Window progress and pending calls can be inspected.
body.zh: 窗口进度与待处理调用可检查。

body.en: The scheduler runs without an inference server.
body.zh: 调度器可不依赖推理服务器运行。

body.en: Compare boundary and eager flush behavior.
body.zh: 可以比较边界刷新与即时刷新行为。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Queue one lookup call and feed four explicit token events to a window-size-four scheduler.
note.zh: 排队一次 lookup 调用，并向窗口大小为四的调度器输入四个明确 token 事件。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: One queued synthetic tool call passes through the production four-token scheduling state machine. No GPU decode, SSE token-boundary validation or throughput measurement.

token 0: wait

token 2: wait
token 3: flush
flushed calls: ['lookup']

body.en: Queue one lookup call and feed four explicit token events to a window-size-four scheduler.
body.zh: 排队一次 lookup 调用，并向窗口大小为四的调度器输入四个明确 token 事件。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/mtp-align.git
cd mtp-align
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: An SSE content chunk is not necessarily one model token, and token counts do not establish actual MTP forward-pass boundaries.
limitations.zh: SSE 内容片段不一定对应一个模型 token，计数也不能确定真实 MTP 前向传播边界。

limitations.en: No GPU throughput benefit is established. The synthetic benchmark uses assumed timing and interruption costs.
limitations.zh: 尚未建立 GPU 吞吐收益证据；合成基准使用假设时间与中断成本。

limitations.en: The proxy is experimental; request isolation, partial tool-call reconstruction and production backpressure require further validation.
limitations.zh: 代理属于实验实现；请求隔离、工具调用分片拼装与生产背压需要进一步验证。

body.en: A buffering policy is easier to evaluate when its state and flush decisions are explicit. This project separates that deterministic mechanism from the inference performance hypothesis it is intended to explore.
body.zh: 缓冲策略的状态与刷新决策明确后，才便于评估。项目将确定性机制与希望验证的推理性能假设分开。

body.en: MTPScheduler maintains a configured window and pending ToolCallBatch. on_token advances the counter and returns WAIT or FLUSH. The proxy connects this mechanism to a streamed HTTP path; the benchmark also drives it with a synthetic timing model.
body.zh: MTPScheduler 维护配置窗口与待处理 ToolCallBatch；on_token 推进计数，返回 WAIT 或 FLUSH。代理将机制连接到流式 HTTP 链路，基准还可使用合成时间模型驱动它。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: MTPConfig defines upstream, listen_port, window_size, flush_policy and max_batch. window_latency_s and tool_overhead_s are synthetic model assumptions. Choose window_boundary or eager to compare scheduling behavior; neither config alone proves a server optimization.
body.zh: MTPConfig 定义 upstream、listen_port、window_size、flush_policy 与 max_batch。window_latency_s 和 tool_overhead_s 是合成模型假设；window_boundary 与 eager 可比较调度行为，但配置本身不证明服务器优化。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
mtp-align bench
# Experimental proxy, with your own compatible upstream:
mtp-align serve --upstream http://localhost:8080 --port 8090 --window 4
